title_en: Marvel Television and Marvel Animation New York Comic Con 2026 Panel — All the Announcements on Upcoming Series Coming to Disney+ as They Happen
summary_en: IGN is reporting live from New York Comic Con 2026, where Marvel Television and Marvel Animation are set to make announcements at a special panel event. Check out our live blog for all the news.
body_en:
IGN is reporting live from New York Comic Con 2026, where Marvel Television and Marvel Animation are set to make announcements at a special panel event on the Empire Stage.
Marvel hasn’t said much of anything about what to expect from the ‘Up Next From Marvel Television and Marvel Animation’ panel, which kicks off at 1.15pm PT / 4.15pm ET / 9.15pm UK time. “Join special guests for an inside look at Marvel Television and Marvel Animation’s most anticipated upcoming series on Disney+,” reads the official blurb.
So, speculation time! With VisionQuest around the corner (October 14), it seems likely that Marvel will offer a final look at the show, which rounds out the WandaVision trilogy of Disney+ series (WandaVision, Agatha All Along, and now VisionQuest). Elsewhere, I wouldn’t be surprised to see a trailer for Daredevil: Born Again Season 3, which will reportedly be its final season . Season 3 is currently expected to premiere in 2027. Maybe we'll get a release date and trailer tonight.
But the bigger picture question here is whether Marvel will announce any further live-action series, amid speculation that it’s pulling back from costly shows ( the cancelation of Wonder Man Season 2 wasn't a great sign ). The Hollywood Reporter has said three to five other shows are in development, including a spy series named Zodiac. But officially, Marvel has yet to announce any further live-action series. Could this panel offer us a roadmap of releases?
As for Marvel Animation, Season 2 of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man is scheduled to premiere on Disney+ in January 2027, so we’ll probably get a look at that. I’d love to see something of X-Men '97 Season 3, which is coming next year. Marvel Zombies Season 2 is in the works — maybe it’s a time for that to shuffle forward.
Not long until we find out! We’ll be at the panel and reporting live below.
UPDATE: 15 minutes to go! It's looking increasingly likely that the panel will start late, with fans still waiting to get inside the Empire Stage. We will keep you updated!
UPDATE: 30 minutes to go! The queue to get in the Empire Stage is huge, so this one may run late. We'll squeeze in for sure though! Stick with us for live updates.
